description: Plain-language explanation of a Solana transaction from one getTransaction read: status, fee, parsed actions (SOL and SPL/Token-2022 transfers, approvals, revokes, account creation and closures), best-effort swap descriptions for Jupiter, Raydium, Orca, Meteora and pump.fun, and Rugsight grades for tokens the transaction touched. Unknown programs are labelled unknown. Automated technical data, not financial advice, not a safety guarantee. The free summary (status, fee, short explanation, programs, movements, up to 3 mint grades) is limited to 10 calls per day per IP. Pass full=true for the full JSON at 0.005 USDC via x402: call once to receive the PaymentRequired object, then retry with _meta["x402/payment"]. Use when you have a Solana transaction signature and need a plain-language explanation of what it did, including Rugsight grades for tokens it touched.

full.description: If true, return the full paid explanation via x402 (0.005 USDC). The free summary is returned when this is omitted or false.
